_route_note: WP6 (MIDTERMS-WP6-1106): practitioner_terms are used only on the technical route (a question without news intent, vera.news_intent). news_terms are used when news intent fires (the same detector as the reporting lane).
_variant_note: F1-QUERY-1106: a variant that is only a year or only these stop-like tokens is never emitted (deny list; config, not code). A year counts as a central concept, and is ANDed in the arXiv query, only together with an event/topic noun.
_r3_note: RELEVANCE-R1R4-1106 R3: with more than one base term a bare one-word variant ("agent", "color") is never tried; hyphenated compounds and entity-central queries are exempt. A flag, not a threshold.
